definitionZh: 按不同中风重量、间距和克宁以及类型其他方面,将样式从打字颜色的轻度调整为粗度。 这一般会改变整体宽度,因此可以与Width和Grade轴结合使用.
sourceDefinition: Adjust the style from lighter to bolder in typographic color, by varying stroke weights, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type. This typically changes overall width, and so may be used in conjunction with Width and Grade axes.
